data.title: Personal liability insurance policy update (Nachtrag Nr. 1)
data.summary: Muster Versicherung AG sent an updated policy for your personal liability insurance (Privat-Haftpflichtversicherung) after your change of address and bank details. The next annual premium of €59.90 will be debited on 1 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is an updated insurance certificate that replaces the one from 24 November 2023. It confirms your new address and bank account. Cover is €10,000,000 with no deductible. The contract renews each year on 1 December unless you cancel in text form at least three months before the end of the insurance year (30 November). The premium of €59.90 is collected automatically by direct debit on 1 December 2026. Check that the details are correct. No action is needed unless something is wrong.
data.tax_note: Liability insurance premiums can be claimed as other provision expenses (Vorsorgeaufwendungen) in the tax return.
